account-entry.title: Your account
account-entry.lead: Refresh current account and session truth before changing anything.
account-entry.notice: Cached facts can be shown, but writes require fresh account/session truth.

account-loading.title: Loading account
account-loading.lead: Current profile, preference version and session status are being refreshed.
account-loading.notice: Wait for fresh truth before editing.

account-offline.title: Saved account view is read-only
account-offline.lead: Last-known preferences remain understandable, but account writes are unavailable.
account-offline.notice: Reconnect and refresh before changing profile, preferences, session, or deletion state.

account-load-failed.title: Account truth is not current
account-load-failed.lead: The read failed before any account operation began.

account-overview.title: Account & preferences
account-overview.lead: Manage your profile and app preferences without changing money, group, wallet, or chain truth.
account-overview.notice: Account settings cannot manufacture identity-provider, wallet, payment, group-owner, or signing authority.

profile-overview.title: Display identity
profile-overview.lead: Your ChopDot display name is presentation, not cryptographic identity.
profile-overview.notice: Changing this name does not change wallets, personhood, groups, balances, or prior history.

profile-edit.title: Edit display name
profile-edit.lead: Prepare a reversible draft before saving.
profile-edit.notice: Draft text is not persisted truth.

profile-invalid.title: That name cannot be saved
profile-invalid.lead: The draft is blank, too long, or otherwise invalid before any write begins.
profile-invalid.notice: Fix the draft; no profile mutation occurred.

profile-review.title: Save Dev Peña?
profile-review.notice: The save is version-checked. A newer profile version will not be overwritten silently.

profile-saving.title: Saving display name
profile-saving.lead: One version-bound profile operation is in progress.
profile-saving.notice: Do not start a second save while this operation is unresolved.

profile-saved.title: Display name saved
profile-saved.lead: The fixture now treats Dev Peña as the current display name.
profile-saved.notice: Verified profile save only; no external identity-provider claim.

profile-conflict.title: Profile changed elsewhere
profile-conflict.lead: The reviewed version is stale and was not overwritten.
profile-conflict.notice: Refresh current profile truth before reviewing a new change.

profile-failed.title: Display name was not saved
profile-failed.lead: The operation failed with a known no-effect result.
profile-failed.notice: A fresh retry is safe because no effect occurred.

profile-unknown.title: Still checking the save
profile-unknown.lead: The request may have reached persistence, so ChopDot will not start a replacement save.
profile-unknown.notice: Reconcile this same operation identity first.

profile-reconciling.title: Checking PROFILE-27-A
profile-reconciling.lead: Current profile truth is being compared with the existing operation.
profile-reconciling.notice: Reconciliation never creates a second profile write.

profile-no-effect-retry.title: No profile effect found
profile-no-effect-retry.lead: Reconciliation proved PROFILE-27-A did not change the profile.
profile-no-effect-retry.notice: A new save can now be reviewed deliberately.

profile-cancelled.title: Display-name edit cancelled
profile-cancelled.lead: The draft was abandoned before a write began.
profile-cancelled.notice: Cancellation does not change current profile truth.

notifications-overview.title: Notification preferences
notifications-overview.lead: Choose what ChopDot should try to notify you about; OS permission remains separate.
notifications-overview.notice: An app preference cannot grant device notification permission.

notifications-edit.title: Edit preferences
notifications-edit.lead: Draft: activity on, reminders off, push on.
notifications-edit.notice: Draft preferences are not effective until saved.

notifications-review.title: Save notification changes?
notifications-review.lead: The app preference can be saved even when OS push permission is absent.
notifications-review.notice: After save, effective push still depends on the system-owned permission.

notifications-saving.title: Saving preferences
notifications-saving.lead: One version-bound preference operation is in progress.
notifications-saving.notice: Do not duplicate the save while the result is pending.

notifications-saved.title: Preferences saved
notifications-saved.lead: ChopDot preference is saved; effective push is still unavailable until OS permission exists.
notifications-saved.notice: Saved app preference is not the same thing as system permission or delivery proof.

notifications-permission-needed.title: Device permission is needed
notifications-permission-needed.lead: Push preference is on, but the operating system still controls permission.
notifications-permission-needed.notice: Open system settings to grant or deny permission. Journey 27 cannot grant it.

notifications-permission-denied.title: Push stays unavailable
notifications-permission-denied.lead: The system-owned permission was denied or remains off.
notifications-permission-denied.notice: The app preference remains distinct; no delivery is claimed.

notifications-conflict.title: Preferences changed elsewhere
notifications-conflict.lead: The reviewed version is stale and was not overwritten.

notifications-failed.title: Preferences were not saved
notifications-failed.lead: The save failed with known no effect.

notifications-unknown.title: Still checking the save
notifications-unknown.lead: The preference write may have happened, so replacement retry is blocked.

notifications-reconciling.title: Checking NOTIFY-27-A
notifications-reconciling.lead: Current preference truth is compared with the existing operation.

notifications-no-effect-retry.title: No preference effect found
notifications-no-effect-retry.lead: Reconciliation proved the prior operation had no effect.
notifications-no-effect-retry.notice: Review a new preference write deliberately.

notifications-cancelled.title: Preference edit cancelled
notifications-cancelled.lead: The draft was abandoned before a write began.

appearance-overview.title: Appearance preference
appearance-overview.lead: System follows the device appearance; Light and Dark are app display preferences.
appearance-overview.notice: Changing appearance never changes account authority or OS settings.

appearance-preview.title: Preview Dark
appearance-preview.lead: This preview is reversible and not persisted yet.
appearance-preview.notice: Leaving without saving returns to the saved System preference.

appearance-saving.title: Saving Dark
appearance-saving.lead: One appearance preference operation is in progress.
appearance-saving.notice: Preview is not used as proof of persistence.

appearance-saved.title: Dark saved
appearance-saved.lead: The fixture now treats Dark as the persisted app appearance preference.

appearance-failed.title: Dark was not saved
appearance-failed.lead: The known failure preserves System as the saved preference.
appearance-failed.notice: A fresh save may be reviewed.

appearance-unknown.title: Still checking THEME-27-A
appearance-unknown.lead: The preference may have saved; replacement save is blocked.

appearance-reconciling.title: Checking saved appearance
appearance-reconciling.lead: Current preference truth is compared with THEME-27-A.

security-overview.title: Current session
security-overview.lead: Review the current signed-in session and sign out without changing account data.
security-overview.notice: Sign-out is not account deletion, credential rotation, or wallet revocation.

signout-review.title: Sign out this device?
signout-review.lead: This ends the current session fixture only.
signout-review.notice: You can cancel before session revocation begins.

signing-out.title: Signing out
signing-out.lead: One current-session operation is in progress.
signing-out.notice: Do not infer signed-out status until verified.

signed-out.title: Signed out on this device
signed-out.lead: The current session fixture is no longer active.
signed-out.notice: No production auth-provider or remote-session claim is made.

signout-failed.title: You are still signed in
signout-failed.lead: The sign-out operation failed with known no effect.

signout-unknown.title: Checking this session
signout-unknown.lead: ChopDot cannot yet prove whether SESSION-27-A revoked the session.
signout-unknown.notice: Reconcile the same operation; navigation cannot decide session truth.

signout-reconciling.title: Checking SESSION-27-A
signout-reconciling.lead: Current session truth is reconciled without starting another revocation.
facts: Signed out / no effect / still unknown

signout-no-effect-retry.title: Session is still active
signout-no-effect-retry.lead: Reconciliation proved the prior sign-out had no effect.

deletion-entry.title: Delete account
deletion-entry.lead: Deletion is guarded because account removal must not orphan group authority or hide unresolved money.

deletion-blocked-owner.title: Transfer group ownership first
deletion-blocked-owner.lead: You still own an active group, so Journey 27 cannot delete the account yet.
deletion-blocked-owner.notice: Group ownership resolution belongs to Journey 26.

deletion-blocked-money.title: Resolve open money first
deletion-blocked-money.lead: Unresolved obligations require their owning money flow before deletion.
deletion-blocked-money.notice: Journey 27 cannot settle, forgive, or zero balances.

deletion-review.title: Review account deletion
deletion-review.lead: Prerequisites are clear in this fixture. Shared and external history will not be described as erased.
deletion-review.notice: Export a copy first if you want one. Deletion affects only the ChopDot account working state modeled here.

deletion-type-confirm.title: Type DEVINSON to continue
deletion-type-confirm.lead: This is deliberate confirmation, not a credential or reauthentication step.
deletion-type-confirm.notice: A mismatched value cannot reach final deletion review.

deletion-mismatch.title: Confirmation did not match
deletion-mismatch.notice: Return and type the exact current display-name confirmation.

deletion-final-review.title: Delete this ChopDot account?
deletion-final-review.lead: This is the last reversible step before a deletion request begins.
deletion-final-review.notice: After execution starts, an unknown result must be reconciled rather than retried.

deletion-requesting.title: Requesting deletion
deletion-requesting.lead: One guarded deletion operation is in progress.
deletion-requesting.notice: Do not start a replacement request while this result is unresolved.

deletion-cancelled.title: Account deletion cancelled
deletion-cancelled.lead: Cancellation happened before deletion execution began.
deletion-cancelled.notice: No account working state was removed.

deletion-failed.title: Account was not deleted
deletion-failed.lead: The request failed with known no effect.
deletion-failed.notice: A fresh retry is safe only because no effect occurred.

deletion-unknown.title: Still checking DELETE-27-A
deletion-unknown.lead: The request may have taken effect, so duplicate deletion is blocked.
deletion-unknown.notice: Reconcile this same delete request identity first.

deletion-reconciling.title: Checking DELETE-27-A
deletion-reconciling.lead: Account truth is checked without creating another deletion request.

deletion-no-effect-retry.title: No deletion effect found
deletion-no-effect-retry.lead: Reconciliation proved the account remains active and DELETE-27-A had no effect.
deletion-no-effect-retry.notice: Return to final review before a new request.

deleted.title: Account working state deleted
deleted.lead: The deterministic fixture now treats this ChopDot account working state as removed.
deleted.notice: This does not claim production backend erasure, provider erasure, settlement changes, wallet effects, or chain deletion.

you-home-boundary.title: You surface owns navigation
you-home-boundary.lead: Journey 27 returns control without creating account outcome truth.

notification-system-boundary.title: System notification settings
notification-system-boundary.lead: The operating system owns notification permission.
notification-system-boundary.notice: This boundary cannot be treated as permission granted merely because it was opened.

ownership-transfer-boundary.title: Group lifecycle owns transfer
ownership-transfer-boundary.lead: Journey 26 must resolve active group ownership before deletion.
ownership-transfer-boundary.notice: Returning here does not itself prove ownership changed; prerequisites are refreshed.

money-resolution-boundary.title: Money journey owns resolution
money-resolution-boundary.lead: Journey 27 cannot settle, forgive, or zero obligations.
money-resolution-boundary.notice: Return only after the owning journey has independently resolved money truth.

export-boundary.title: Export / Portability owns your copy
export-boundary.lead: Journey 24 owns user-controlled export before deletion.
export-boundary.notice: Return to deletion review after export or cancellation; export does not widen deletion authority.
